versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.  
- Internal version bump; no updates to documentation or logic.

- Initial release of the context-slimming skill for OpenClaw agent workspaces.
- Provides step-by-step methods to diagnose and optimize injected context (.md) files, aiming to reduce per-round token consumption.
- Includes recommended file downsizing strategies, deduplication guidelines, and optional classical Chinese (文言化) compression.
- Offers practical examples, before/after size data, and verification steps for workspace context slimming.
- Trigger phrases and use cases clearly listed for audit and optimization workflows.
